select c.quartername as jd,a.ORGNAME as ImpLssuedUnitName , t.REALNAME as ImpLssuedStaffidName,r.* from TBL_RISK_IMPLEMENT r left join TBL_MAJORRISK_BRANCHCREATE c on c.id=r.majorid left join TBL_MAJORRISKCREATE cr on cr.id=c.majorid left join TBL_ORGANIZATION a on r.IMP_LSSUED_UNIT=a.ORGID left join TBL_STAFF t on r.IMP_LSSUED_STAFFID=t.STAFFID where 1=1 and r.toreport=1
and IMP_RISK_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impRiskName} ),'%')
and c.quartername LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.jd} ),'%')
and a.ORGNAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impLssuedUnitName} ),'%')
and r.id in
#{item}
${sql}
order by imp_risk_name,id desc

select c.QUARTERNAME as jd,c.RISKYEAR as nd,a.ORGNAME as ImpLssuedUnitName ,t.REALNAME as ImpLssuedStaffidName,r.* from TBL_RISK_IMPLEMENT r left join TBL_MAJORRISK_BRANCHCREATE c on c.id=r.majorId left join TBL_MAJORRISKCREATE cr on cr.id=c.majorid left join TBL_ORGANIZATION a on r.IMP_LSSUED_UNIT=a.ORGID left join TBL_STAFF t on r.IMP_LSSUED_STAFFID=t.STAFFID where 1=1 and r.toreport=1
and IMP_RISK_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impRiskName} ),'%')
and a.ORGNAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impLssuedUnitName} ),'%')
and r.id in
#{item}
and r.IMP_WAY_STAFFNAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impWayStaffName} ),'%')
and r.IMP_WAY_DEPTNAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impWayDeptName} ),'%')
and r.IMP_RISK_DETAILS LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impRiskDetails} ),'%')
and r.IMP_THIS_CONTROL LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.impThisControl} ),'%')
and c.RISKYEAR LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.nd} ),'%')
and c.QUARTERNAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.jd} ),'%')
${sql}
order by imp_risk_name,id desc
